title: Endpoints
description: Every public name bpvps1 and bpvps2 serve, as Grafana's probes see it from outside: up or down, and TLS days left per hostname. The names are derived by vps/shared/public-endpoints.py; copy of record is grafana/dashboards/endpoints.json in Blueprint-Agency/infrastructure, applied by scripts/grafana-apply.py. Edits made in the UI are overwritten on the next apply.

panels.title: TLS days left, per hostname
panels.description: The certificate each name actually serves to a browser -- for the proxied Kaiteki names that is Cloudflare's edge certificate. Alert: tls-expiry, below 21 days.

panels.title: Up, from every probe
panels.description: 1 when the probe succeeded in the last 31 minutes -- the same window the endpoint-down-15m rule uses, so a gap here is a real failure and not a check that has simply not run yet at the 15-minute cadence most names use (#42). Alert: endpoint-down-2m / endpoint-down-15m, when the probe fails two runs in a row.
